name: Git Graph
description: The repository's commits as a graph, with branch and commit actions, like vscode-git-graph.

settings.title: Commits to load
settings.description: How many commits the graph loads at first, and how many more each Load more adds.

settings.title: Show remote branches
settings.description: Show remote branches when a graph opens (the toolbar's Remotes button switches them per graph).

settings.title: Show uncommitted changes
settings.description: A row for the uncommitted changes on top of HEAD.

settings.title: Dim commits HEAD doesn't reach
settings.description: Fade the commits that aren't ancestors of HEAD.
